obs: "And what presumption is there that an exclusion of juries from trials as to trade and revenue, for causes like thee, was meant to be extended to torts ?The -reason is totally inapplicable, and hence the presumption .entirely fails."
Maislin Industries, U. S., Inc. v. Primary Steel, Inc.
"Cessante ratione legis, cessat et ipsa lex."
Utility Air Regulatory Group v. EPA
"The maxim cessante ratione legis cessat ipse lex—where a law’s rationale ceases to apply, so does the law itself—"
